verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents connecting financial integrations such as Brex and Ramp, which are card/spend platforms whose transactions get categorized in Puzzle. It also documents reconciling bank and credit-card accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of direct bank-account connections (bank feeds), evidence that imports happen automatically on a daily schedule, a list of supported banks and card issuers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: 98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
2x faster to close books When you connect Ramp with Puzzle
performing a reconciliation is the best way to ensure every single transaction is accounted for and matches your bank statement exactly
